Continuation e7d1ab4e alive.

attributes.summary: Revision r3 addressing audit r2 (1H/3M). Every mutation now a literal command: mkdir/touch for the skeleton, a mechanical .env constructor from `supabase status -o env` handling both key eras with an abort-and-report-names branch (values never reported), an explicit git-add allowlist with a porcelain assertion, the exact commit command, and a TREE CLEAN check. Verification renumbered as V1-V5 (unit, e2e, lint, dev probe, adapter assertion) with playwright install moved to setup; capture/commit split into step 9 recording V1-V5 by number. S4 rewritten: Done/entity.completed requires V1-V5 + TREE CLEAN + Supabase green; a Docker-blocked run is never Done - it is entity.progressed with M1 item 1 explicitly open.

Revision r3 addressing audit r2 (3H/3M). R2 boundary closed: validated magnitude domain [1e-9,1e15] (MAG_MIN/MAX in np/1, overflow/underflow rationale), PricePoint {float, decimal} output type with a lossless plain-decimal serialisation rule (exponential renderings expanded by string transform; zero serialises as '0'), out-of-magnitude-domain typed error, trailing-zero equality and float-collapse cases specified with tests. Public contract now fully declared in TypeScript: ReconcileOutcome union (never throws), ReconcileResult with role-keyed input/distances/honesty, LayerTrace/CurvePoint/SignalValue shapes, EngineVersionMeta, and a static FIELD_CLASSES path map with a structural completeness test. F1 symmetry escalated instead of reinterpreted: new s6 Q1 puts the T2 s4 amendment to the operator (mirror symmetry provably not an invariant of the ported maths; argument-order invariance proposed), property 4 marked provisional. Fixture archive regenerated with an anchors block (reconciliation/1, np/1, honesty/1, engine 0.1.0) - maths content verified unchanged; golden tests now assert full meta, toleranceMode, zone, and anchor equality. Property arbitraries pinned constructively (five geometry generators in v-notation incl. a guaranteed zero-width construction; one fc.assert per geometry, seed 20260820). Zero-width now runs the natural maths yielding the prototype's two-layer trace plus the convergedTrivially flag (former single-layer deviation removed). Honesty aligned with T2 s3.5's letter: null-with-reason for skewness/kurtosis only, rangeCompression evaluates to 0, exactly-four-ascending precondition documented.

attributes.summary: Operator ruling needed on T2-engine s4's role-direction symmetry property. A faithful port cannot satisfy a full price-axis mirror (geometric means and low-oriented grid tie-breaks are not reflection-invariant); the T3 proposes amending T2 s4 to argument-order invariance (swap the two parties' argument positions => identical role-keyed result), with an optional weaker reflection property on the reflection-invariant methods as alternative b2. Property 4 of the T3 runs the argument-order floor provisionally until ruled. Raised by audit r2, held through r3; details in T3-m1-engine-port s6 Q1.
